title: Desk top with shaped birch ply stands
summary: A new desk top with cable slots, and two shaped stands built up from layers of birch ply.
intro: A desk for a home office in Wood Green: a new top with cable slots, and two shaped stands that sit on it. The stands were built up from layers of birch ply and routed to a template, so the curves come out clean and matching.
